meta.source: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), product and UPI ecosystem statistics, captured by the local Data Bank
meta.vintageNote: NPCI publishes no revision date for its statistics and edits past rows in place without notice; these are its tables as the Data Bank captured them on the archiveCapturedDate.
meta.revisionPolicy: NPCI edits past rows in place without notice (it revised April 2023's UPI volume, and NETC's February and March 2026 in October 2026). Each capture is the table as NPCI then showed it; the Data Bank keeps every capture.
meta.coverage: Every day since 1 May 2021: number and value of UPI, IMPS, FASTag, AePS, cheque, ATM-network (NFS) and NACH transactions
meta.note: NPCI's daily tables, printed in million and ₹ crore to two decimals, stored as counts and rupees; small daily figures are coarse (AePS fund transfers often print 0.00 million). Days are transaction days. Known NPCI slips kept as printed: FASTag 19 November 2022 (103.0 million, about ten times its neighbours), the ATM network (NFS) 1 October 2021 (124.76 million, about eleven times its neighbours), BHIM Aadhaar Pay 1 December 2021 (5.00 million against well under 0.1 million on the days around it), AePS cash withdrawals in December 2021 (one tenth of the usual count) and 5 November 2022 (value ten times), IMPS in February 2023 (several days understated), every NACH tab 0 on 28 February 2025. The cheque table omits some holidays. NPCI's daily NACH credit excludes APBS, which has its own table. The running month is in NPCI's table only to the latest day shown.
